{{Quote|Greetings, Gentles! It is I, your culinary caretaker Ms. Gormaanda to once again guide your taste receptors on an ethereal journey.|Gormaanda, leading off her column|<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|life/1344_2.html|Gormaanda's Culinary Corner: Glowblue Noodles & Chav}}</ref>}}
"'''Gormaanda's Culinary Corner'''" was a column that appeared in [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] [[Holofeed/Legends|newsfeeds]] throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the Republic's final [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the availability of fresh ingredients in Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] was becoming increasingly rare. [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] responded by sharing a recipe for [[Glowblue Noodles and Chav]], which could me made with a wider variety of different meats, or none at all. In her column, Gormaanda cared for her readers' appetites as well as their pocketbooks.
